headline: Russian Wheat Farmers Turn to Plastic Storage Bags as Black Sea Trade Stalls
summary: Russian agricultural producers are resorting to giant plastic bags to store unexported grain as Black Sea drone attacks disrupt shipping routes. Russia is the world's top exporter of wheat.
why: Russia is the leading global exporter of wheat; shipping bottlenecks in the Black Sea threaten global agricultural commodity supply chains.

impacts.name: Wheat Futures
impacts.why: Black Sea trade disruptions delaying Russian grain exports support global wheat prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Black Sea logistical disruptions restricting Russian wheat shipments put upward pressure on international agricultural futures.
